name: lemniscate-mcp

tools.name: lmns_chain
tools.description: List names with listed options, or read one name's option chain: strike grid per Daily or Weekly speed with bid, ask, daily cost in USDG, breakeven and Greeks per option unit. Read only.

tools.name: lmns_quote
tools.description: Price a buy or a sell of an option series in USDG: total, fee, daily cost, breakeven, volatility used and why a buy might be blocked. Read only.

units.description: Option units as a decimal string, for example "2.5".

tools.name: lmns_positions
tools.description: Open positions of an account: units after funding, value at bid, today's cost, cost basis and profit or loss. Read only.

owner.description: Account the position belongs to. Defaults to the configured owner.

tools.name: lmns_pool
tools.description: Writer Pool state: NAV, exposure per name, stress, caps usage and queue size. Read only.

tools.name: lmns_vol
tools.description: Volatility inputs for one name: the latest signed sigma post per speed (Daily or Weekly) with its age and expiry, any buy-block window around earnings, and the recent post history. Read only.

name.description: Ticker such as NVDA, TSLA, SPY or QQQ.

speed.description: Keep only this speed's latest post.

tools.name: lmns_receipts
tools.description: Recent hourly receipts: the Merkle root over each hour's trades, volatility posts and Writer Pool NAV snapshots, with how many of each it covers. The roots are published by the Lemniscate API (not written on chain). Newest hour first. Read only.

limit.description: How many hours to return. Default 24.

tools.name: lmns_status
tools.description: Service health: whether the stock market session is open, price-feed and volatility freshness per name, indexer lag and warnings. Read only.

tools.name: lmns_policy
tools.description: Read the on-chain AgentRouter policy an owner set for an agent: budget, spent, remaining, per-trade cap, expiry, allowed names, sell and Shield rights, plus the owner's USDG balance and approval to the router. Read only.

owner.description: The owner: the wallet that set the agent's policy, pays for buys and receives the options and proceeds.

agent.description: The agent's own address: the key that will sign the trade. Never the owner's.

tools.name: lmns_setup_agent
tools.description: For the OWNER: prepare the two unsigned transactions that let an agent trade for them through the AgentRouter: a USDG approval to the router (up to the budget) and setPolicy (budget, per-trade cap, expiry, allowed names, sell and Shield rights). The owner signs both, in order. Nothing is sent.

owner.description: The owner: the wallet that set the agent's policy, pays for buys and receives the options and proceeds.

agent.description: The agent's own address: the key that will sign the trade. Never the owner's.

budgetUsdg.description: Total USDG the agent may spend on buys over the policy's life (a lifetime cap).

maxPerTradeUsdg.description: Most USDG a single buy may cost.

days.description: Days until the policy expires. Default 7.

items.description: Ticker such as NVDA, TSLA, SPY or QQQ.

names.description: Tickers the agent may trade, for example ["NVDA", "SPY"].

canSell.description: Let the agent sell the owner's options (proceeds go to the owner).

canShield.description: Let the agent buy Shield (Weekly Down options) on the owner's Stock Tokens.

tools.name: lmns_revoke_agent
tools.description: For the OWNER: prepare the unsigned transaction that revokes an agent's AgentRouter policy, and an optional one that sets the router's USDG approval back to zero. Nothing is sent.

owner.description: The owner: the wallet that set the agent's policy, pays for buys and receives the options and proceeds.

agent.description: The agent's own address: the key that will sign the trade. Never the owner's.

tools.name: lmns_prepare_buy
tools.description: Prepare an unsigned AgentRouter buy of option units for the owner, for the agent to sign with its own key. Checks the owner's on-chain policy and USDG balance and approval, then simulates the call as the agent. Options are minted to the owner. Nothing is signed or sent.

units.description: Option units as a decimal string, for example "2.5".

owner.description: The owner: the wallet that set the agent's policy, pays for buys and receives the options and proceeds.

agent.description: The agent's own address: the key that will sign the trade. Never the owner's.

slippageBps.description: Allowed price move in basis points. Default 50.

deadlineSeconds.description: Seconds the order stays valid. Default 300.

tools.name: lmns_prepare_sell
tools.description: Prepare an unsigned AgentRouter sell of option units the owner holds, for the agent to sign. Allowed only when the owner's policy lets the agent sell; proceeds go to the owner. Simulated as the agent first. Nothing is signed or sent.

units.description: Option units as a decimal string, for example "2.5".

owner.description: The owner: the wallet that set the agent's policy, pays for buys and receives the options and proceeds.

agent.description: The agent's own address: the key that will sign the trade. Never the owner's.

slippageBps.description: Allowed price move in basis points. Default 50.

deadlineSeconds.description: Seconds the order stays valid. Default 300.

tools.name: lmns_prepare_shield
tools.description: Prepare an unsigned Shield for the owner: a Weekly Down option protecting Stock Tokens they hold, at a level below the price, bought through the AgentRouter at exactly the quoted strike. Allowed only when the owner's policy allows Shield. Nothing is signed or sent.

name.description: Ticker such as NVDA, TSLA, SPY or QQQ.

tokenUnits.description: Stock Token amount to protect, decimal string.

strikePctBelowBps.description: How far below the price to protect, in basis points. Default 1000.

owner.description: The owner: the wallet that set the agent's policy, pays for buys and receives the options and proceeds.

agent.description: The agent's own address: the key that will sign the trade. Never the owner's.

slippageBps.description: Allowed price move in basis points. Default 50.

deadlineSeconds.description: Seconds the order stays valid. Default 300.

tools.name: lmns_submit
tools.description: Broadcast a transaction the agent (or owner) already signed, for Lemniscate calls only on this chain: AgentRouter trades and policy, engine trades, and USDG approvals to the router or engine. It is simulated first; anything else, or a call that would revert, is refused and never sent.

tools.name: lmns_tx
tools.description: Read a sent transaction's result: success or reverted, block, gas used, and any agent trade it made through the AgentRouter (owner, agent, series, buy or sell, USDG). An unknown hash reads as pending. Read only.

instructions: Lemniscate: everlasting call and put options on Stock Tokens, settled in USDG on Robinhood Chain (chain 4663). This public server holds no keys. Read and quote freely (lmns_chain, lmns_quote, lmns_status, lmns_pool, lmns_positions, lmns_policy). To trade for a human owner: the owner runs lmns_setup_agent once and signs its two transactions; then lmns_prepare_buy, lmns_prepare_sell or lmns_prepare_shield returns one unsigned AgentRouter transaction for the agent's own key. Sign it, broadcast it (or hand it to lmns_submit), then read it with lmns_tx. The AgentRouter enforces the owner's budget, per-trade cap, expiry and names on chain, and mints to the owner.
